A fruit fly that is homozygous recessive for <span style="color: #006b6f;">Gene K</span> has a body shape that is curved, similar to a kidney bean.</li> <li><strong><span style="color: #9a3160;">Gene Y</span></strong> is associated with the '<span style="color: #9a3160;"><i>yucky</i></span>' phenotype.
